subject: Greenwave BYO-key operator profile & audit chain — handoff checklist
messages:
From: Marta Suarez <marta.suarez@greenwavehealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 11 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BYO key handoff — operator profiles and audit chain

Hi Tessa,

We're ramping to the private deployment cutover week-of Jul 25 and need to lock the BYO-key handoff details. Security has asked for a short operator profile document (who has wrapping/unwrapping privileges, emergency escrow contacts) and a clear audit chain for each action (attester, timestamping, evidence storage). Can Redwood confirm:

- Operator separation model you recommend for Greenwave (role names + minimal privileges)
- How Redwood surfaces HSM attestation proofs in the audit trail
- Rotation cadence you expect us to commit to for KEK and application-level keys

If possible we'd like an internal checklist we can present to procurement and our InfoSec gate this Thursday. Attaching our high-level constraints in a separate email.

Thanks,
Marta
Head of IT Security
Greenwave Health

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marta Suarez <marta.suarez@greenwavehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BYO key handoff — operator profiles and audit chain

Hi Marta — thanks for the note and the timeline.

High-level answers up front, and I attached a one-page runbook + network diagram for your gate: gw_byo_runbook_draft.pdf, gw_vpc_network_diagram.png (links below). Full details follow in thread.

- Operator separation: we recommend 3 distinct roles for BYO HSMs at cutover:
  1) Key Custodian (customer side) — can initiate wrap/unwrap requests and request emergency export clauses; no console admin.
  2) Operator (Redwood) — performs HSM orchestration actions (seal/unseal, proxy wrap, rotate KEK) under mutual auth and documented approvals.
  3) Auditor/Verifier (read-only) — RBAC view for audit evidence, attestation receipts and logs.

All actions are gated by an approval token that requires one Custodian + one Operator for critical flows. We avoid single-person criticality.

- HSM attestation: Redwood will collect vendor-signed attestation blobs (JSON) on each HSM key import and publish them to the audit ledger. Attestation includes firmware version, device serial, and an attester signature timestamped by our internal signing service.

- Rotation cadence: recommended KEK rotation cadence is 12 months for production; application keys you control more frequently (90 days) depending on your lifecycle policy. We support emergency rotations with zero-downtime replay via prefix caching.

Next steps we propose:
1) Review attached runbook and mark any objectionable operator privileges.
2) Sign the mutual action form (DocuSign) so we can start operator onboarding.
3) Schedule a 45-minute ops rehearsal with CryptoTap to exercise attestation pull.

I copied Marcus to coordinate the rehearsal (networks) and Vivek for attestation + telemetry specifics.

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Product Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: CryptoTap Support <support@cryptotap.io>, Marta Suarez <marta.suarez@greenwavehealth.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jul 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: FW: BYO key handoff — attestation and rotation questions

Hi CryptoTap — looping you in. Two specific clarifications from Greenwave's InfoSec:

1) Attestation schema: we need to verify the exact fields you include in the device attestation blob (serial, fw, CDIs, vendor cert chain). Can you confirm the JSON schema and signing algorithm (ECDSA/P-256 vs RSA-2048)?
2) Remote audit retrieval: can your management endpoint publish an immutable attestation bundle to a URL with a signed timestamp so Redwood can anchor it in our ledger?

We'd like a short test-case during the rehearsal: import a test KEK, generate attestation, and have Redwood pull and display the receipt in the audit UI.

Thanks — Vivek

From: CryptoTap Support <support@cryptotap.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marta Suarez <marta.suarez@greenwavehealth.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jul 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: BYO key handoff — attestation and rotation questions

Hi all,

Thanks for the outline. CryptoTap attestation details below:

- Schema: our attestation blob is a CBOR/JSON hybrid; we export a base64 JSON envelope with fields: {device_serial, firmware_version, key_id, key_curve, attester_cert_chain, timestamp, signature_alg}. We support ECDSA P-256 signatures by default and can provide an RSA-2048 chain on request.
- Signed timestamping: we produce a signed bundle and can host a short-lived HTTPS endpoint per customer where bundles are posted. Each bundle includes a monotonic counter and RFC-3161-compatible timestamp token.
- Test rehearsal: we can import a non-production KEK and push the attestation bundle to the Redwood rehearsal endpoint. We'll need firewall egress to support outbound to s3-redwood-relay.greenwave.example.com:443 and the IPs in the attached vendor allowlist (we'll send as a separate attachment).

We will forward formal schema docs and an allowlist shortly.

Regards,
CryptoTap Support

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: BYO key handoff — operator profiles and audit chain 

Thanks everyone — consensus and next steps below.

Summary of agreements:
- Operator roles: adopt the 3-role separation (Custodian / Operator / Auditor). Greenwood InfoSec to supply custodian names by EOD Wed Jul 13.
- Attestation ingestion: CryptoTap will provide a test bundle and allowlist; Redwood will ingest and anchor to our ledger in rehearsal.
- Rotation: plan KEK rotation on a 12-month cadence; emergency rotations allowed with mutual approval token.

Action items (owners):
- Marta: finalize custodian list and procurement approval (procurement@greenwavehealth.com) — due Wed 2027-07-13.
- Marcus: schedule rehearsal network window and confirm VPC peering rules — due Fri 2027-07-15.
- Vivek: prepare the attestation ingestion endpoint and sample UI receipt for the rehearsal (will include attest blob and signed timestamp) — due Mon 2027-07-18.
- Tessa: send DocuSign mutual action form and attach the runbook + diagram for InfoSec gate.

Attachments sent: gw_byo_runbook_draft.pdf (runbook, operator privileges table), gw_vpc_network_diagram.png (VPC peering and firewall rules). DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/sign/03A7G5KQ

If there are no objections we'll proceed with the rehearsal scheduling this week.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Product Manager, Private Deployments
